first_page: Photos page /photos/ for people who want their pictures private. First: the existing device library as a full page: timeline by day, albums, favourites, trash with undo, crop/rotate/light editor that saves a new copy, a places map from EXIF, and export without location. Will not build: cloud backup, face recognition, AI edits or prints.
